author: Prachi Bhardwaj
title: Apple won $539 million from Samsung in a patent lawsuit - an amount that's barely noticeable against Apple's net profits (AAPL)
text: Apple won $539 million from Samsung in a patent lawsuit — an amount that's barely noticeable against Apple's net profits (AAPL) By Prachi Bhardwaj May 25, 2018, 5:22 pm 24 pts The $539 million that Apple won in its patent infringement case against Samsung is fairly insignificant compared to the some $300 billion of profit Apple has made in the years since it filed the suit in 2011. The money is nice, but for Apple, the real victory probably comes from the principle of the…
